name: Compliora
tagline: Regulatory certainty for every gram you grow, hold, or sell.
positioning: Compliora turns state cannabis rules into a clean, auditable record — built for individual cultivators, patients, and single-license operators.

hero.h1: Compliance that keeps pace with your license.
hero.sub: Track every plant, package, and lab result in a single ledger that mirrors your state's rules — so renewals, audits, and reconciliations stop being a scramble.

features.title: Seed-to-sale ledger
features.description: Log clones, harvests, and transfers with timestamps and weights that reconcile automatically against your state tracking manifests.

features.title: License renewal watch
features.description: Compliora surfaces expiring permits, pending attestations, and fee deadlines weeks ahead, with a checklist tuned to your jurisdiction.

features.title: COA & lab vault
features.description: Store certificates of analysis, cure logs, and batch photos in one indexed archive — the exact packet an inspector asks for.

features.title: Audit-ready exports
features.description: Generate a clean, chronologically ordered compliance file on demand, formatted for regulators and cultivation counsel alike.

features.title: Reconciliation alerts
features.description: Weight discrepancies, missing manifests, and untagged inventory are flagged the moment your numbers drift out of tolerance.

features.title: Jurisdiction rulepacks
features.description: Rule logic is maintained per state and county, so your workflow updates when the statute does — no PDF spelunking required.

testimonials.quote: I hold a single micro-cultivation license and used to dread renewal season. Compliora assembled my entire compliance packet in an afternoon. My inspector barely had questions.
testimonials.name: Marisol Vega

testimonials.quote: The reconciliation alerts caught a mislabeled package before it ever hit a manifest. That one flag likely saved my license.
testimonials.name: Declan Reyes

testimonials.quote: As a registered patient cultivating at home, I finally have a defensible record of every plant and cure. It reads like a proper audit file, not a spreadsheet.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

pricing.blurb: For patients and hobby cultivators keeping a defensible personal record.
For single-license cultivators and boutique sellers who face real audits.
For multi-license portfolios and compliance advisors managing clients.

homepage.footerBlurb: Compliora is a compliance recordkeeping platform and does not provide legal advice. Rulepacks are maintained for informational accuracy only.
